# Adscendo

> Adscendo designs fast websites and apps for small businesses, built to be found on Google and recommended by ChatGPT. New sites from $400 at launch.

Adscendo is the web design and development studio of Jean Menezes, founded in October 2026. It builds websites and apps for small and mid-size businesses in the United States, Brazil and elsewhere, in English and Portuguese. English site at https://adscendo.pro/, Portuguese at https://adscendo.pro/pt.

## Services

- [Websites](https://adscendo.pro/websites): Website designer for small businesses: custom sites designed for phones, fast, and built to be found on Google and recommended by AI. From $400 at launch.
- [Apps](https://adscendo.pro/apps): Apps for iPhone, Android and the web, designed and built by Adscendo, from the first idea to the App Store, Google Play and live online.
- [AI consulting](https://adscendo.pro/ai-consulting): Put AI to work in your business: an assessment, less busywork, AI agents for customer service and team training. The first conversation is free.
- [AI optimization](https://adscendo.pro/ai): A new website built so ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity can read, trust and recommend your business. AI optimization included, from $400 at launch.

## Website cost in the US (2026)

From our guide at https://adscendo.pro/website-cost:

- You, on a website builder like Wix or Squarespace: roughly $200 to $600 a year in plan fees, plus the hours you put in.
- A freelancer: often $1,000 to $5,000, depending on their experience and how much they write and design for you.
- A small studio: often $1,000 to $10,000. Ours run from $400 to $1,900 at launch prices.
- An agency: often $5,000 to $30,000 or more, with a team of designers, writers and developers.

## Prices (USD)

- A new website, from scratch: $800, or $400 with the 50% launch discount
- A new version of your website: $1,200, or $840 with the 30% launch discount
- A new website, with your integrations: $2,000, or $1,900 with the 5% launch discount
- Estimate only. Final price after a closer look at your project.

## Questions

### What does Adscendo do?

Adscendo is a web design and development studio that builds websites and apps for small and mid-size businesses. Every site is designed for phones, loads fast and is set up to be found on Google and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

### How does a project work?

In three steps. First we meet to learn how your business works and where you want to go. Then we design and build a first version you can try on your own phone and computer. Finally we adjust what's needed and put it live. You never have to touch anything technical.

### How much does a website cost?

Our websites run from $400 to $1,900 at launch prices, one price for the whole project. Our website cost guide compares builders, freelancers and agencies and explains what changes the price.

### Do you work with businesses outside the US?

Yes. Adscendo is a Brazilian studio that works remotely with businesses in the United States, Brazil and anywhere else, in English or Portuguese. Your site can have one language or several.

### Who founded Adscendo, and where is it based?

Adscendo was founded in October 2026 by Jean Menezes, a Brazilian designer and developer. Before Adscendo he spent years designing and building digital products for enterprise companies, including projects for McDonald's, AT&T, Petronas, PagBank and Multilaser. The studio is based in Brazil and works remotely with small businesses in English and Portuguese.

### How do I get started?

Answer a few questions in the chat at adscendo.pro. It takes less than a minute and gives you a first estimate right away. We reply within 6 hours by email, or on WhatsApp if you prefer.

## Em português

A Adscendo cria sites e apps rápidos para pequenas empresas, feitos para aparecer no Google e ser recomendados pelo ChatGPT. Sites novos a partir de US$ 400. Site em português: https://adscendo.pro/pt. Nossos preços são em dólar: usamos a mesma tabela para clientes no Brasil e nos Estados Unidos.

### O que a Adscendo faz?

A Adscendo é um estúdio de design e desenvolvimento que cria sites e apps para pequenas e médias empresas. Todo site é pensado para o celular, carrega rápido e é preparado para ser encontrado no Google e recomendado por assistentes de IA como ChatGPT, Gemini e Perplexity.

### Como funciona um projeto?

Em três etapas. Primeiro fazemos uma reunião para entender como seu negócio funciona e aonde você quer chegar. Depois desenhamos e construímos uma primeira versão, que você testa no seu celular e no seu computador. Por fim, ajustamos o que for preciso e colocamos no ar. Você não precisa mexer em nada técnico.

### Quanto custa um site?

Nossos sites vão de US$ 400 a US$ 1.900 com o desconto de lançamento, num preço só para o projeto inteiro. O guia quanto custa um site compara plataformas, freelancers e agências e explica o que muda o preço.

### Vocês atendem empresas no Brasil?

Sim. A Adscendo é um estúdio brasileiro que trabalha de forma remota com empresas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e em qualquer lugar, em português ou inglês. Seu site pode ter um idioma ou vários.

### Quem fundou a Adscendo, e onde ela fica?

A Adscendo foi fundada em outubro de 2026 por Jean Menezes, designer e desenvolvedor brasileiro. Antes, ele passou anos desenhando e construindo produtos digitais para empresas de grande porte, com projetos para McDonald's, AT&T, Petronas, PagBank e Multilaser. O estúdio fica no Brasil e atende pequenas empresas de forma remota, em português e inglês.

### Como eu começo?

Responda algumas perguntas no chat em adscendo.pro/pt. Leva menos de um minuto e já mostra uma primeira estimativa. Respondemos em até 6 horas por email, ou pelo WhatsApp se preferir.
